subject: Re: Saturday bun mission
text:
Hey,

Sorry I went quiet for two days, my brain melted after work and I meant to ping you sooner. Anyway, I’m still up for Saturday if you are. I found that little place by the river that’s supposed to do giant cinnamon buns, plus they’ve got board games nobody’s ruined yet. If the weather behaves, maybe we grab coffee after and walk around like normal people.

Just say the word and I’ll book something, unless you’ve suddenly got plans with your mysterious weekend project. No pressure either way, honestly. I’m just hungry for buns.

Catch you soon,
Me
